en.hubeali:
And by his chain, 
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘
There are three signs for the show-off – He is active when he sees the people (around him), and he is lazy when he is alone, and he loves to be praised in the entirety of his affairs’.
en.sarwar: 8. He (Ali ibn Ibrahim) has narrated through his chain of narrators the following: “Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali ibn abu Talib (a.s.) has said, ‘
A showoff has three signs: he is very active when people are present, very lazy when he is alone and he loves to be praised in all matters.’”
